rentalExpenseAllocation.title: Publication 527, Residential Rental Property (2024)
rentalExpenseAllocation.pinpoint: Chapter 1 pp. 4–5 (cash expenses, ownership, insurance and expense character); chapter 4 pp. 22–24 (allocation by rental period and reasonable methods); chapter 5 pp. 25–28 (actual-use days, dwelling used as home, days used as main home before/after renting).
rentalExpenseAllocation.implementation: Compute rental portions from preserved expense source amounts and documented methods. The >=12-consecutive-month main-home exception changes the dwelling-used-as-home limitation classification, not expense allocation. Unsupported section 280A deduction-limit worksheets and section 1341 claims block. Depreciation requires the actual year/retirement-adjusted workpaper amount, never prorated capital basis. A repayment requires explicit source-income year, deduction year, and deductible-character decision.
rentalExpenseAllocation.syntheticExample: 2024 annual insurance 3660; rental period Jan 1–Jun 30 (182 days), main home Jul 1–Dec 31 (184 days), with qualifying earlier rental history: rental insurance 1820, personal insurance 1840.
